subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 grouped upstream Action upgrades in privileged token, scanning, publishing, and agent workflows after the rebased exact-head gates pass?
rationale: Source inspection finds no mechanical defect, but only repository owners can accept the trust and operational boundary change created by executing new upstream Action code with secrets and elevated repository permissions.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Rebase, verify each official release pin, require the action-security and affected workflow checks to pass, then approve the grouped update.

options.title: Split privileged upgrades
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL, and Codex Action changes into smaller PRs if owners want independent rollout and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Pause the group
options.body: Leave the PR open until Dependabot access and exact-head validation stabilize rather than merging an unrefreshable grouped branch.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify each official release pin, require the action-security and affected workflow checks to pass, then approve the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-wide automation trust decision spanning release, security, and agent workflows, and the timeline directly routes the PR to this owner.
